Changelog

audit.workbench 0.6.26

Bug fixes and minor improvements

  • The pip check installs numpy into a temporary virtual environment, so it no longer changes the user’s own Python. It also works where system pip is externally managed (PEP 668), and finds Python in /opt/python when python3 isn’t on the PATH (#39).

audit.workbench 0.6.25

Bug fixes and minor improvements

  • check() no longer stops outside the RStudio IDE when rstudio-server isn’t on the PATH. It also looks in /usr/lib/rstudio-server/bin, and otherwise reports the Workbench version as unknown. Requires audit.base 0.7.8 (#38).

audit.workbench 0.6.24

Bug fixes and minor improvements

  • CI uses actions/checkout@v5, read-only permissions, and installs Quarto, so the Quarto Python test runs on CI (#45).

audit.workbench 0.6.23

Bug fixes and minor improvements

  • debug_level = 2 keeps the Quarto and R Markdown render folders, as documented (#45).
  • check_python_pip and check_python_reticulate have their own R6 class names; both were check_python (#45).
  • check() no longer claims a NULL server falls back to WORKBENCH_SERVER (#45).
  • Fix the check_rmd help title and description, import R6 and re-knit README.md (#45).

audit.workbench 0.6.22

Bug fixes and minor improvements

  • check() no longer stops when /opt/R, /opt/python or /opt/quarto is missing; it reports the folder as not found (#37).
  • check_file_permissions fails when new files in the home directory are writable by other users, or not readable and writable by their owner. It no longer deletes ~/tmp-file-creating.txt (#42).
  • check_cran and check_github install their test packages into a temporary library, so the user’s library is left as it was (#43).

audit.workbench 0.6.21

Bug fixes and minor improvements

  • check_posit_drivers() compares the highest installed driver version when multiple versions are present, and reports none found as not installed (#45).

audit.workbench 0.6.20

Bug fixes and minor improvements

  • check_verify_installation is now check_test_config, and runs rstudio-server test-config. verify-installation refuses to run while the server is up, so the old check always failed inside a session. Use test_config in place of verify_installation in config files (#36).

audit.workbench 0.6.19

New features

  • check_quarto_python builds a virtual environment from audit.base’s Quarto Python document and renders it with the Jupyter engine. It uses python3 on the PATH, or the newest Python in /opt/python. Requires audit.base 0.7.2 (#3).

Bug fixes and minor improvements

  • Remove the unused inst/extdata/python example, whose 2023 pins don’t install on Python 3.14.

audit.workbench 0.6.18

New features

  • check_reticulate_r_versions runs each R in /opt/R with its own site settings, and fails if any lacks {reticulate} or has a RETICULATE_PYTHON that is unset or not an executable file (#5).

audit.workbench 0.6.17

New features

  • check() runs audit.base::check_timezone(), and the report says whether R can determine the server’s timezone. Requires audit.base 0.7.1 (#32).

audit.workbench 0.6.16

Bug fixes and minor improvements

  • Add an air.toml, so air formats with = assignment and 100-character lines.

audit.workbench 0.6.15

New features

  • check_verify_installation runs rstudio-server verify-installation and fails if it does (#6).

audit.workbench 0.6.14

New features

  • check_r_options fails when the HTTPUserAgent or download.file.extra R option is unset (#4).

audit.workbench 0.6.13

Bug fixes and minor improvements

  • Remove the core_r_pkgs check, which always failed. check_sys_libs() already covers system libraries (#19).

audit.workbench 0.6.12

Bug fixes and minor improvements

  • Issues now use the Jumping Rivers organisation templates.
